name: Existing Patient Booking Handoff
description: Existing patients asking for another visit should stay in the handoff branch, avoid free-text reason collection, and createReceptionTask should happen only after phone confirmation.

messages.content: Dzien dobry, chce umowic kolejna wizyte na higienizacje. To nie jest moja pierwsza wizyta, bylem juz u was. Mam na imie Test Staly Pacjent, moj numer to siedem zero dwa, zero zero trzy, zero zero dziewiec.

PASS if, on this first assistant turn, the assistant stays in the existing-patient handoff branch. A helper lookupPatient call for speech-safe phone confirmation is allowed. It must not ask for a short description or more treatment details, and it must not call checkAvailability, createEvent, or createReceptionTask yet. Output exactly: pass or fail.

PASS if, after the phone confirmation, the assistant calls createReceptionTask with taskType existing_patient_booking, does not ask for a short description or symptom narrative anywhere in the conversation, and does not call checkAvailability or createEvent anywhere in the conversation. Output exactly: pass or fail.
